items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I know that Mr. Allen MacMillan... knows what was happening in this business.

ctx.x: And only for Miss Billie Holiday... O.K., he's the greatest man.
He's a great man and he's still with the press today, 1973.
